about: Items whose worth to a role is mostly an effect the stat weights cannot count (a proc, a use), kept by hand. In the lists of that role that are ranked on the weights, such an item gets no score: it is shown level with the best picks, flag x. See _build/specs.py (unvalued). Add an item only when what its effect is worth is not known; one whose effect is measured belongs to a simulated list. placed: items the stat weights give nothing (their worth is all effect), so that no list would hold them: in a list ranked by simulation, such an item is put right after the item named in "after", with no score, and is never a best pick; a list that does not hold that item does not hold it either.

11815.name: Hand of Justice
11815.effect: Chance on hit of an extra attack; the score counts its 12 attack power alone, which left it out of every PvP list.

13966.name: Mark of Tyranny
13966.effect: Use: +620 health for 15 s, 5 min cooldown; the score counts its 12 dodge alone.

14557.name: The Lion Horn of Stormwind
14557.effect: When struck: 5% chance (doubled in Strongholds and Cities) of +725 armor to the party for 30 s, 60 s cooldown; the score counts its 8 defense alone.

18168.name: Force Reactive Disk
18168.effect: Classic's deals damage to the attackers on a block; WoWSims Forever's database has no effect for it and the game was not read: to check. The score counts its armor and its stamina alone.

18348.name: Quel'Serrar
18348.effect: Chance on hit: +300 armor and +30 defense for 10 s; the score counts its damage and its stamina alone.

19024.name: Arena Grand Master
19024.effect: Use: Aura of Protection, an absorb, for 20 s, 9 min cooldown; the score counts its 12 dodge alone.

22321.name: Heart of Wyrmthalak
22321.effect: Melee and ranged attacks have a chance to deal Fire damage (2 a minute in WoWSims Forever, whose own gear sets wear it); 13 Fire resistance is all the weights see. Placed after Hand of Justice on the user's word (2026-11-21): no score, and not before it.
